data.content: PLAN (Claude, 2026-07-02, lease hive-flow-9a1d). NATURE: empirical battle-test campaign + fix slices, not a single code slice. LIVE INVENTORY (verified via provider_status just now): gemini-cli (binary IS agy 1.0.15 — the sign-in-parity target named in scope), codex-cli 0.142.5, cursor-cli 2026.07.01, deepseek + openrouter (credential-holder APIs). lmstudio is NOT in the current provider_status enum despite the landed LMSTUDIO agent-provider slice — determining its actual exposure path (or recording the gap) is itself a Phase 0 item. PRIOR ART (reference only, never current truth): .tmp-audit/provider-harness-stress/ holds the interrupted pre-migration campaign (WAVE1-MANIFEST.md, 12 shards A-L, 43 result files) whose known findings list is partially stale — owner-stamp contamination, liveness currentTaskPid, and statusboard classes were fixed in later slices (78a255d81, 253a950ce, C4 lane), so Phase 0 re-baselines everything at current HEAD. PHASES (strictly sequential, each with disk-persisted evidence under .tmp-audit/harness-battle-0bb4/results/, harvested from disk not context): PHASE 0 baseline re-canary matrix — one agent per live provider exercising file/artifact, run_command, web, and result-stamping paths; re-verdict each legacy finding (run_shell backend, web_fetch allowlist, web_search parser, delete/move tool absence, statusline tallies, grep/find allowlist) as FIXED or STILL-OPEN with evidence; agy sign-in/session parity headless-vs-terminal; lmstudio exposure check. PHASE 1 load and concurrency — ramp pilots to documented per-provider caps (respect the landed caps slice; never stop on rate limits, redirect/reduce per standing handoff), long-horizon tasks with explicit generous timeouts to exercise deadlineAt reaper interplay. PHASE 2 stall/blocker auto-recovery battery — induced scenarios: silent no-result agent, slow agent, dead-PID agent, permission-waiting agent; verify rewake terminal-status clearing, reaper reclaim without killing legitimate long jobs, sentinel done-marker aggregation, queen escalation ONLY when appropriate, permission denial to structured redirect, watchdog nag suppression when a BLOCKED note exists; produce a watchdog blindspot matrix (flow-watchdog/sentinel/rewake trigger conditions crossed against agent states busy/idle/blocked/waiting-queen/terminal) and enumerate spam-loop and silent-hang cells. PHASE 3 error-catalog coverage — representative re-probes from the runtime-error-permission-audit A3 families at current HEAD; verify denials yield structured redirection/help (artifact hints, stderr logs) not dead ends; include cross-repo CWD/projectRoot handling probes. PHASE 4 triage, fix, re-verify — consolidate findings by semantic issue, adversarially verify with provider-balanced verifiers, then every verified defect becomes a CHILD KNOT (autopilot_no_planning profile, linked parent_of) implemented by Claude and reviewed/landed by Codex with regression tests, re-canary after each fix; defects that are legitimately deferred go through the 5e15 deferral ledger with full six-field records. DELIVERABLES: campaign evidence tree + final report (provider-by-capability matrix, findings ledger FIXED/STILL-OPEN/NEW, recovery-path proofs) attached to this knot; fix-slice child knots with tests; watchdog blindspot matrix; deferral-ledger records for anything parked. CONSTRAINTS: waves run via Hive Flow provider agents and queen-led hives (the campaign IS dogfooding); untracked flow-watchdog.cjs and protected .claude/helpers fixes route to Codex as verbatim patches per precedent; campaign scale handled by sharded distinct prompts + disk self-persistence (proven pattern, survives compaction). RISKS: provider quota/rate limits (redirect or reduce scope, never stop); LM Studio absence (conditional lane, gap recorded via ledger if unavailable); long-horizon tests crossing compaction boundaries (durable taskIds + disk harvest mitigate); induced-stall tests must use scratch tasks so the reaper never reclaims real work. COMPLEXITY: HIGH — multi-session campaign; implementation state will span several dispatch/harvest cycles with fix child-knots landing along the way. TEST STRATEGY: each fix slice carries focused regressions in the suite nearest the touched surface; every fix gets a live re-canary; knot shipment requires the final report plus all child knots shipped or ledger-recorded.
